G0.name: Base Inspection & Capability Inventory
G0.notes: Dedicated Python 3.11 venv initialized, all geospatial dependencies installed and verified (rasterio 1.4.4, geopandas 1.2.0, shapely 2.2.0, scipy 1.15.2, pyproj, networkx, pystac_client, fastapi, uvicorn).

G1.name: Schemas, Grid, Jobs/Store, Provenance & Health
G1.notes: Pydantic v2 schemas in schemas.py, atomic store and SQLite index in store.py, dynamic metric UTM grid generator in geo/grid.py, /api/track-b/health endpoint in api.py.

G2.name: Sentinel-1 STAC Discovery & Same-Track Pairing
G2.notes: Discovery in providers/stac.py and pairing in providers/sentinel1.py enforcing same relative orbit, acquisition mode, polarization, and ~12-day repeat.

G3.name: SAR Water & Change Detection (Otsu & Terrain Uncertainty)
G3.notes: Refined Lee speckle filtering in linear power, Otsu thresholding in dB space, 2D finite-difference slope mask (>20 deg) for radar shadow/layover exclusion in geo/flood.py and geo/masks.py.

G4.name: Sentinel-2 Optical Corroboration & Candidate Debris
G4.notes: SCL cloud and invalid pixel masking in geo/masks.py, candidate debris delineation using delta-NDVI loss, SWIR bare-soil reflectance, and DEM valley flow corridors in geo/debris.py.

G5.name: ohsome Historical OSM Ingestion & Road Network Topology
G5.notes: Historical pre-event geometry extraction with strict timestamp enforcement in providers/ohsome.py; multigraph topology preserving all connected components in geo/road_graph.py.

G6.name: Asset Exposure Intersection (Buildings, Roads, Bridges)
G6.notes: Geometric intersection against fused hazard envelope; metric areas, segment lengths, unique ID tracking, and bridge inspection priorities in geo/exposure.py.

G7.name: Pre/Post Access Connectivity & Cut-Off Settlements
G7.notes: NetworkX shortest path routing to hospitals and towns comparing baseline vs post-event optimistic and precautionary closure scenarios in geo/accessibility.py.

G8.name: Deterministic Fact Store & Grounded Bilingual Copilot
G8.notes: Immutable server-side fact store in reports/facts.json, read-only typed tools in copilot/tools.py, Devanagari & English templates in copilot/templates.py, adversarial question refusal in copilot/validators.py.

G9.name: Frontend Track B Studio, Evidence Dashboard & Exports
G9.notes: Dedicated React/Leaflet dashboard at frontend/src/app/track-b/page.tsx with multi-layer map, clicked-feature evidence panel, bilingual copilot, and printable HTML situation reports.

G10.name: Trishuli Case Study Freeze & EMSR927 Checking
G10.notes: Completed end-to-end run run_20261014_165946_2a3de6 on Trishuli August 2026 event. Prediction frozen with SHA-256 hash 77de531347a94ac5b7eb5468c788e784c27eae83ff5fa7fc5f60abb95edc40ed. Quarantined validation runner in validation/emsr927.py.

G11.name: DEM Downstream Flow Path Bonus & ML Pipeline Configs
G11.notes: D8 gravitational flow routing and downstream settlement corridor buffer in geo/downstream.py; isolated Kuro Siwo ML dataset and inference lane with honest model_unavailable handling in ml/infer.py.

G12.name: Documentation, <=6-page Report, Video Script & Final Rehearsal
G12.notes: submission_report.md (exact 6-page allocation), demo_script.md (180s storyboard), demo_recording_checklist.md, case_study.md, limitations.md, scripts/track_b_doctor.sh, scripts/track_b_demo.sh.
